Name: SNOMEDCTBodyStructures
Title: SNOMED CT Body Structures
Description: This value set includes all codes from [SNOMED CT](http://snomed.info/sct) where concept is-a 442083009 (Anatomical or acquired body site (body structure)).

Name: Condition/Problem/DiagnosisCodes
Title: Condition/Problem/Diagnosis Codes
Description: Example value set for Condition/Problem/Diagnosis codes.

Name: ProcedureDeviceActionCodes
Title: Procedure Device Action Codes
Description: Example codes indicating the change that happened to the device during the procedure.  Note that these are in no way complete and might not even be appropriate for some uses.

Name: FHIRDeviceTypes
Title: FHIR Device Types
Description: Codes used to identify medical devices. Includes concepts from SNOMED CT (http://www.snomed.org/) where concept is-a 49062001 (Device)  and is provided as a suggestive example.

Name: EventStatus
Title: EventStatus
Description: Codes identifying the lifecycle stage of an event.

Name: CommonLanguages
Title: Common Languages
Description: This value set includes common codes from BCP-47 (http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47)

Name: SNOMEDCTMedicationAsNeededReasonCodes
Title: SNOMED CT Medication As Needed Reason Codes
Description: This value set includes all clinical findings from SNOMED CT - provided as an exemplar value set.

Name: ParticipantRoles
Title: Participant Roles
Description: Roles of participants that may be included in a care team.  Defined as: Is a Person, Healthcare professional (occupation) or Healthcare related organization (qualifier value).

Name: ProcedurePerformerRoleCodes
Title: Procedure Performer Role Codes
Description: This example value set defines the set of codes that can be used to indicate a role of a procedure performer.

Name: ProcedureCategoryCodes(SNOMEDCT)
Title: Procedure Category Codes (SNOMED CT)
Description: Procedure Category code: A selection of relevant SNOMED CT codes.

Name: ProcedureCodes(SNOMEDCT)
Title: Procedure Codes (SNOMED CT)
Description: Procedure Code: All SNOMED CT procedure codes.

Name: ProcedureFollowUpCodes(SNOMEDCT)
Title: Procedure Follow up Codes (SNOMED CT)
Description: Procedure follow up codes: A selection of SNOMED CT codes relevant to procedure follow up.

Name: ProcedureNotPerformedReason(SNOMED-CT)
Title: Procedure Not Performed Reason (SNOMED-CT)
Description: Situation codes describing the reason that a procedure, which might otherwise be expected, was not performed, or a procedure that was started and was not completed. Consists of SNOMED CT codes, children of procedure contraindicated (183932001), procedure discontinued (416406003), procedure not done (416237000), procedure not indicated (428119001), procedure not offered (416064006), procedure not wanted (416432009), procedure refused (183944003), and procedure stopped (394908001).

Name: ProcedureOutcomeCodes(SNOMEDCT)
Title: Procedure Outcome Codes (SNOMED CT)
Description: Procedure Outcome code: A selection of relevant SNOMED CT codes.

Name: ProcedureReasonCodes
Title: Procedure Reason Codes
Description: This example value set defines the set of codes that can be used to indicate a reason for a procedure.

Name: QuestionnaireAnswerCodes
Title: Questionnaire Answer Codes
Description: Example list of codes for answers to questions. (Not complete or necessarily appropriate.)

Name: QuestionnaireResponseStatus
Title: QuestionnaireResponseStatus
Description: Lifecycle status of the questionnaire response.

Name: RequestIntent
Title: RequestIntent
Description: Codes indicating the degree of authority/intentionality associated with a request.

Name: RequestPriority
Title: Request priority
Description: The clinical priority of a diagnostic order.

Name: RequestStatus
Title: RequestStatus
Description: Codes identifying the lifecycle stage of a request.

Name: ServiceRequestOrderDetailsCodes
Title: Service Request Order Details Codes
Description: An example value set of Codified order entry details concepts.  These concepts only make sense in the context of what is being ordered.  This example is for a patient ventilation order

Name: FHIRSpecimenCollectionMethod
Title: FHIR Specimen Collection Method
Description: This example value set defines a set of codes that can be used to indicate the method by which a specimen was collected.

Name: SpecimenContainerType
Title: Specimen Container Type
Description: Checks on the patient prior specimen collection. All SNOMED CT concepts descendants of 706041008 |Device for body fluid and tissue collection/transfer/processing (physical object)|

Name: SpecimenProcessingProcedure
Title: Specimen processing procedure
Description: The technique that is used to perform the process or preserve the specimen.

Name: SpecimenStatus
Title: SpecimenStatus
Description: Codes providing the status/availability of a specimen.

Name: GenomicStudyTypeVS
Title: Genomic Study Type ValueSet
Description: Backport of http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/genomicstudy-type

Name: Hl7VSAdditivePreservative
Title: hl7VS-additivePreservative
Description: Concepts specifying any additive introduced to the specimen before or at the time of collection.  These additives may be introduced in order to preserve, maintain or enhance the particular nature or component of the specimen.  Used in Version 2 messaging in the SPM segment.

Name: Hl7VSSpecimenType
Title: hl7VS-specimenType
Description: Concepts that describe the precise nature of an entity that may be used as the source material for an observation.  This is one of two code systems that are used instead of table 0070 (code system xxxx) which conflated specimen types and specimen collection methods.   Used in Version 2 messaging in the SPM segment.

Name: Hl7VSSpecimenCondition
Title: hl7VS-specimenCondition
Description: Concepts of modes or states of being that describe the nature of a specimen.  Used in Version 2 messaging in the SPM segment.

Name: Hl7VSRelevantClincialInformation
Title: hl7VS-relevantClincialInformation
Description: Value Set of codes that specify additional clinical information about the patient or specimen to report the supporting and/or suspected diagnosis and clinical findings on requests for interpreted diagnostic studies.

Name: ServiceDeliveryLocationRoleType
Title: ServiceDeliveryLocationRoleType
Description: A role of a place that further classifies the setting (e.g., accident site, road side, work site, community location) in which services are delivered.

Name: GenomicTRFOrderCategoryVS
Title: Genomic TRF Order Category ValueSet
Description: Permitted high-level genomic requisition categories.
